Filling_level.label: Filling level
Filling_level.description: The uCIFI filling level sensor measures how full and/or how empty a container (e.g. waste, fuel) is and reports it either in percentage or in centimeters. The filling level sensor may be complemented with a temperature sensor to compose a waste filling sensor that can also identify waste container fire.

Actual_filling_percentage.label: Actual filling percentage
Actual_filling_percentage.description: Percentage of container filled with content.

Actual_filling_level.label: Actual filling level
Actual_filling_level.description: Height of content in the container.

High_threshold.label: High threshold
High_threshold.description: Threshold above which the container is considered full.

Container_full.label: Container full
Container_full.description: Set to True if the actual filling percentage is above the high threshold.

Low_threshold.label: Low threshold
Low_threshold.description: Threshold below which the container is considered empty.

Container_empty.label: Container empty
Container_empty.description: Set to True if the actual filling percentage is below the low threshold.

Forecast_full_date.label: Forecast full date
Forecast_full_date.description: Next date at which the container should reach the high threshold.

Forecast_empty_date.label: Forecast empty date
Forecast_empty_date.description: Next date at which the container should reach the low threshold.

Container_out_of_location.label: Container out of location
Container_out_of_location.description: Set to True if the container is not at the location where it should be.

Container_out_of_position.label: Container out of position
Container_out_of_position.description: Set to True if the container is not in correct upright position.

Container_installation_type.label: Container installation type
Container_installation_type.description: Type of the container. Examples are underground, above ground.

Container_volume_max.label: Container volume max
Container_volume_max.description: The maximum volume available in the container for waste items.

Filling_sensor_position.label: Filling sensor position
Filling_sensor_position.description: The position of the filling sensor inside the container.

Type_of_materials.label: Type of materials
Type_of_materials.description: The type of the materials the container can be filled with. Examples are plastic, glass.

Filling_operations_counter.label: Filling operations counter
Filling_operations_counter.description: Total amount of filling operations performed.

Cover_open.label: Cover open
Cover_open.description: Set to true if the cover of the container is open and the filling level cannot be estimated. This is valid if the filling level sensor is installed under the cover of the bin.

Temperature_alarm.label: Temperature alarm
Temperature_alarm.description: Set to true if the sensor detects a fire using either a temperature sensor object.and/or a gas detection object.

Water_infiltration_alarm.label: Water infiltration alarm
Water_infiltration_alarm.description: Set to true if the sensor detects water infiltration or a high humidity level.

Timestamp.label: Timestamp
Timestamp.description: The timestamp of when the measurement was performed.

Fractional_Timestamp.label: Fractional Timestamp
Fractional_Timestamp.description: Fractional part of the timestamp when sub-second precision is used (e.g., 0.23 for 230 ms).

Measurement_Quality_Indicator.label: Measurement Quality Indicator
Measurement_Quality_Indicator.description: Measurement quality indicator reported by a smart sensor. 0: UNCHECKED No quality checks were done because they do not exist or can not be applied. 1: REJECTED WITH CERTAINTY The measured value is invalid. 2: REJECTED WITH PROBABILITY The measured value is likely invalid. 3: ACCEPTED BUT SUSPICIOUS The measured value is likely OK. 4: ACCEPTED The measured value is OK. 5-15: Reserved for future extensions. 16-23: Vendor specific measurement quality.

Measurement_Quality_Level.label: Measurement Quality Level
Measurement_Quality_Level.description: Measurement quality level reported by a smart sensor. Quality level 100 means that the measurement has fully passed quality check algorithms. Smaller quality levels mean that quality has decreased and the measurement has only partially passed quality check algorithms. The smaller the quality level, the more caution should be used by the application when using the measurement. When the quality level is 0 it means that the measurement should certainly be rejected.

Reset_filling_operations_counter.label: Reset filling operations counter
Reset_filling_operations_counter.description: Total amount of filling operations performed.
